The Road Code · Daily Lesson

I Can’t Stop. I Gotta Get There.

November 3, 2026 · Walterboro, South Carolina · Day 1,281 · 66,610.4 documented miles

I Can’t Stop. I Gotta Get There. — the film, 4:41

Seven days off the bike — a full week at the desk, writing the book. Day 1,281, he rolled out again: out the gate pointed at Walterboro, straight away to the book.

Diesel wind on a two-lane road. Eighteen wheels running close and low.

Mid-ride, he stopped at Canaan Baptist and prayed it out loud: “Lord, bless everything that’s going on right now.”

Then the FAITH sign — letters standing ten feet high. “That’s what it says — that’s the answer to the question, right there.”

“I’m doing the right thing. No doubt.” Walterboro. Day 1,281 in the books — the day’s own song, OUTGROW YESTERDAY, carrying the whole ride, end to end.

The lesson: a week at the desk doesn’t rust a man who knows why he sat down. You don’t lose the road by stopping to write the story — you lose it by never rolling out again.

R.O.D.A. — Roll On, Doubt Answered.
